# PR #5093: Patch: deeper card stats, X5, an Iteration column on the Experimental tab: v1, v2, and v1b for a change only in play

Closes #5035

## What changed

Each play version now has an **iteration**. `jackioh_cards::play_versions_of` counts it once, over the card's whole shipped history:

- A card's first play version is `v1`.
- A play version takes a **new number**, and its letters start over, when the version it begins at has a change line on the card itself that moves a field the face shows. Those fields are `FACE_FIELDS`, defined next to `WORDING_FIELDS` and `PLAY_VERSION_QUIET_FIELDS`, and the list is exactly the one in the issue.
- **Any other** play version takes the next letters: b to z, then aa. This uses the same `next_letters` that names micros. It was moved from `crates/tools` to `jackioh_cards::versions`, and tools re-exports it.

How it reaches the page:

- **Engine:** `PlayVersion` gains `iteration` and `iteration_letters`, plus `iteration_label()`. `PlayVersionFigures` gains `iteration`, the label. The constants `ITERATION_MARK` and `FIRST_ITERATION` sit next to `PLAY_VERSION_MARK`.
- **Route:** every row of `GET /api/stats/versions` now sends `"iteration": "v1b"`. Hall of Fame rows send it too, because they reuse the same rows. The server code itself is unchanged.
- **Web:** `PublicPlayVersion.iteration?` is new. `RunningPanel` adds an **Iteration** column right of Since on Major patch running, Historical and Versions, in both the table and the grid. The header has a tooltip, there is no note on the page, and the column is not sortable. A row from an older server shows "—". Two zh-CN strings are added.
- **Spec:** new ruling R5035000 and `spec/pending/5035.md`. §9.11 gains two sentences. R4675000, R4678001 and R4680000 are marked as amended.
- **Docs:** the server and cards READMEs are updated.

## How I tested it

All of these passed:

| What | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Cards history tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --lib patch_history` | 13 passed, including the 3 new `r5035000_*` tests |
| Cards, full suite | `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` | 11150 + 1271 passed |
| Engine stats tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib wire::stats::` | 103 passed, including the new `r5035000_*` |
| Engine lib, full | `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit,ts --lib` | 619 passed |
| Tools, letter tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh r3631000` | 3 passed |
| Tools, full | `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` | 641 passed (25 daily ignored), acceptance 61 passed |
| Server route tests | `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r4675001_play_versions` | 2 passed |
| Web tests | `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx src/stats/versions.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` | 3 files, 150 tests passed |

Also clean:
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, and eslint on the touched web files
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-tools -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check`
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`, which reports `Internal`
- `apps/web/src/wire` has no diff

I did not run the whole-workspace `cargo test` or the full web suite locally; the harness runs both.

**Real-data numbers**, read off the new server's route (base `patches.json`): 4,052 play versions of 800 deck cards. 1,576 are numbers and 2,476 are letters, and every card starts at `v1`. Profe Yates reads v1, v2, v2b, v3, v4. The longest run is xxFreshJack, `v1` to `v1ag`.

## UI walkthrough

I used the `ui-walkthrough` skill against the E2E server. For the "before" shots I had already rebuilt the server; the old client ignores the extra field, which also shows an old client works with the new server.

- **1280×720, before:** Running and Versions headers read Card, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted ↓, Since.
- **1280×720, after:** Iteration sits right of Since on both views. Running shows the live version's label: "Miss" Mrow `v3b`, /fullsend `v1c`, A Wee Whelp `v2`. On Versions, "Miss" Mrow's four rows read `v1`, `v2`, `v3`, `v3b`, and /fullsend's read `v1`, `v1b`, `v1c`. The header's `title` is the tooltip and it has no `aria-sort`.
- **390×844, after:** the Running table still scrolls sideways inside its frame (626/364 px). Scrolled to the right edge, Since and then Iteration show, and the header isn't clipped. The Versions grid's figures end with "Iteration v1", and that label carries the tooltip.
- **Tab row:** 461/366 px both before and after, so it scrolls the same as before. This change doesn't touch it.

The EN button is missing from the "after" top bar. That is not this change: it hides once the browser has settled on a language (R1916000).

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Sent as a label** (`"v1b"`) rather than a number and a letter. The client would only have joined them.
- **`grants` is not a face field**, following the issue's list. The history has two `grants` lines, and both also change the card's text, so the count comes out the same either way.
- **An `added` line is never a face change.** The first version is always `v1`, and no card in the history was added twice.
- **A token restarted by its card's change gets a letter**, since nothing on the token's own face moved.
- **I also amended R4680000**, which the issue doesn't list, because Versions gets the column too.
- **The Major patch running cut keeps each row's whole-history iteration.** I added assertions for this in the engine test and in the server's `r5040000_` test.
- **Unchanged:** the drill-down, the Hall of Fame panel and the CLI's `format_play_versions` text table.
- **The server isn't listed in the ruling's `proven_in`.** Its new assertions sit inside the existing `r4675001_` and `r5040000_` tests, and I didn't rename those tests.
- **No sort key.** #5033's Date sort isn't on main yet. The ruling only says sorting by when a version began belongs to #5033.

## For a reviewer to look at twice

- In `play_versions_of`, the `previous =>` arm works out the number from the card's last play version. A version only counts as a face change for a card if one of that card's own change lines moves a face field.
- The tooltip says "what the card shows changed: its name, cost, text, keywords or stats" instead of "its face". The page's Face control already uses "face" for Normal vs Radiant, so the word would be confusing there.
- `main` has moved since this branch's base (3cfb4e3b94). Of the files this branch touches, it only changed `patches.json` (new ships). The real-data test checks properties rather than fixed labels, so new ships shouldn't break it.
